recipes.name: Party Chicken Salad
ingredients_raw: 1 (8 ounce) can crushed pineapple in juice, undrained

steps.text: Mix mayonnaise, sour cream, and curry powder in a bowl until smooth.

Toss apple and lemon juice in a large bowl. Stir in chicken breast meat, celery, green grapes, pecans, and pineapple. Pour mayonnaise mixture over chicken; toss to combine. Cover and refrigerate until chilled.

raw_recipe.headline: Party Chicken Salad
raw_recipe.description: This quick salad is a great way to use up leftover chicken. With a bit of curry, sweet fruit, and crunchy pecan, your next party is sure to be a hit.

review.reviewBody: I modified for BBQ. 4 C mayo, 2 C sour cream, 4 teas curry blend and put in fridge. 2 small apples, juice from 1 lemon, 8 C cooked chicken breasts cubed, 2 C finely chopped celery, 2 C grapes, 1.5 C pecans, 1# precooked firm pasta. Basically prepared as recipe as instructed. Made just over 18 cups salad. Loved the curry. Did not use pineapple. This is a keeper :)

I took another reviewers (brilliant) advice & made this as a cold pasta salad although I'm sure it is delicous as is for a sandwich or crossaint.. I used 1/2 pound of cooked bowtie pasta, 3 boiled & shredded chicken breast, 2 cups mayo, 1 cup sour cream, 2 teaspoons curry, 1 1/2 cups celery, 1 1/2 cups red grapes (what I had), 1 pink lady apple, everything about this was perfect! Moist, crunchy, & delicious! I omitted the pecans & pineapple because I didn't have them on hand, I may add the pineapple to see how it flavors it next time but there is plenty of crunch without the pecans! Thank you!

This salad was absolutely delicious. The flavor profile is a cross between a classic waldorf and curry chicken salads. I made it as written, but used red grapes instead of green for color. The recipe didn't specify what type of apple, so I chose Granny Smith. 
Next time, I think I would add a little salt to bring out more flavor, maybe 1/4tsp and a little freshly ground black pepper, too. I will definitely be making this again, served on all-butter croissants. yum YUM!!! yummyummmm...it was so good, I'm going to go make another sandwich RIGHT NOW! :p

I love this recipe. I am vegetarian so instead of chicken I substitute either tofu, seitan, or Quorn meatless pieces. Other than that, I follow the recipe. Just thought I'd share that information if anyone would like to make it vegetarian it is still excellent.

I made this recipe tonight at our cottage but changed it because I did not have the exact ingredients. I used plain yoghurt instead of sour cream, walnuts instead of pecans and red grapes instead of green ones. I also halved the dressing and even had some left over and the salad was still moist and good. The curry is the essential ingredient. I have other chicken salad recipes similar to this but not with curry. Both my husband loved it and I will make it again.

I have been making this for 15 years and it is a favourite stand-by. I have never tried it with pineapple, but will next time . I use plain yogurt instead of sour cream and add 1tbs mango chutney to the dressing. This complements the curry powder and adds a sweet touch. Raisins and/or dried cranberries are great if you have no grapes on hand. Final party tip: serve it in cantaloupe melon cups or quarters.

I have made a similar recipe for years so I am sure this is wonderful. I did not try it because I reduce the mayo and sour cream and add some yogurt to make it less guilty and healthful. In addition, I add mandarin oranges and half a jar of chutney cut up. The chutney really makes a unique and interesting flavor note and you won't miss some of the fat you left out.

I made this for my son's wedding rehearsal dinner, and it was a HIT...people I have'd even met before came up to me asking for the recipe...I added tiny bow-tie pasta and raisins...it was a hit!! I did use mandarin oranges instead of pineapple...making it again for a 4th of July picnic...

A local tea room served a chicken salad that I loved, so I experimented until I made one very similar to it. This recipe is almost exactly the one I came up with. I did not use apples; I did use whatever I had..raisins, sliced strawberries, grapes, etc. I did not use sour cream; I also added lemon juice and a touch of sugar; and instead of pecans the tea room used salted peanuts (I have also made it with pecans) but I will try the new ideas..sour cream, etc. this recipe uses. I've learned this is a great "make ahead"...it's better if kept refrigerated overnight. The recipe has been requested every time I've served it to guests!

I’ve made this recipe twice now and the three of us really liked it. I added a cup and a half (uncooked) of small pasta to make it a one-dish meal. Next time I make it I think I will try draining the pineapple at least partly. The juice helps flavor the dish but I don’t like the puddle in the bottom of the serving bowl.
Very good. I used Mandarin Oranges instead of Pineapple that was suggested from another Review. Saved as a Favorite.

Delicious 😋 I poached a bone-in chicken breast so cut the recipe by half. I didn't use all the dressing but agree with other reviewers that the curry powder makes the dish. I used half an unpeeled Pink Lady apple (the skin isn't thick, and it adds color) and chopped all the ingredients finely except the chicken, which I cut in 1" cubes. Yummy!

I loved it but not everyone in the family did. Someone described it so accurately as a cross between a waldorf & curry chicken salad. Next time, I would drain the pineapple because mine was a little watery.
Made this recipe and it was great. Easy to make a and delicious!

I will only review a recipe if I made it exactly according to the RECIPE. It’s an unusual combination of ingredients, but it is really,really good!i loved the sweetness of the pineapple. Would never have thought of adding pineapple to chicken salad, but along with the crunchy ness of the apple, celery and pecans it’s was awesome! Will keep this recipe and make again.
Delicious

So disappointed!!! Essentially, this is a crunchy grape salad with mayo & sour cream dressing...and some other stuff.

It was bland, boring - almost tasteless - with too much dressing. We served it to guests, based on ratings :(. The tastes which predominated were grape & the dressing (but with no influence from the curry powder, which I bought specifically to make this salad [Morton & Bassett brand, best by June 2021]). Celery, apple, and pecans added crunch, which was crucial, but no taste. Followed the recipe exactly (using fresh pineapple with its juice, which should only have improved it). 

If you like very mild flavors plus grapes - not challenging to the palate - this is a good option. Or if you eat a lot of chicken salad & want something different, try it, but only if you have the ingredients on hand & don't spend extra money. I have a similar, generations-old recipe from my husband's great-aunt, and will be returning to that one.
I made this as close to the original as possible, using what I had on hand. So delicious! It can be tweaked to suite your tastes/dietary needs and what you have on hand. It's a keeper!
I like this fruity chicken salad. I was out of celery and grapes, but added some mandarin oranges. I really like the dressing with the curry powder.
Amazing as written!
